announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results. This follows recent licence sales and drilling updates in Zambia.

announcements.headline: Molefe Project Drilling Update, Zambia
announcements.insight: Drilling results at Molefe follow earlier licence updates. Shareholders should monitor if this activity supports the remaining portfolio.

announcements.headline: Completion of Sale of 2 Kalahari Copper Licences
announcements.insight: The sale of two copper licences completes the process announced in June. This finalizes the disposal agreed for $3m.

announcements.headline: New Porphyry System at Ferber, Nevada
announcements.insight: Galileo Resources reports a new porphyry system at Ferber. This follows the sale of copper licences and a licence update, suggesting ongoing exploration activity.

announcements.headline: Luansobe Licence Update
announcements.insight: This update follows the June conditional sale of two copper belt licences. Shareholders should monitor for completion details regarding the Luansobe licence.

announcements.headline: Luansobe Licence Update
announcements.insight: Luansobe Licence Update follows the June conditional sale of two Copper Belt Licences. Shareholders should watch for details on how this update relates to the disposed assets.

announcements.headline: Conditional Sale of 2 Copper Belt Licences for $3m
announcements.insight: Galileo Resources disposes of two copper belt licences for $3m. This represents a material asset disposal for the company.
